classification.difficultyReason: Read gradient and intercept, calculate two points and translate their coordinates into a straight-line graph using the specified method.

content.prompt: Write down the gradient and $y$-intercept of each line. Draw a graph of each line by plotting two points.

answer.worked:
In $y=mx+c$, $m=2$ and $c=1$.
$$\begin{align*}y\big|_{x=0}&=2(0)+1=1\\y\big|_{x=1}&=2(1)+1=3\end{align*}$$
Plot $(0,1)$ and $(1,3)$, then draw the straight line through them.

spec.description: Complete answer graph with axes and two labelled points; no grid or ticks, consistent with the teacher sketch.
